hero.name: Rohit Gurunath Thakur
hero.title: Senior Backend Engineer — Payments, CBDC & Real-Time Settlement
hero.tagline: I lead a team of 8 engineers building India's national payment infrastructure: a real-time securities settlement platform settling ₹700+ Crore (INR 7B+) daily, and a CBDC transaction engine sustaining 6,000 TPS at 99.9% availability. Now relocating to Dubai, UAE.

about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Backend Engineer at Mindgate Solutions with 4+ years of experience building high-scale, regulated payment systems in Java and Spring Boot. My work sits at the core of India's digital payments infrastructure — the national Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC / Digital Rupee) platform, UPI instant payments, and Demat 2.0 real-time securities settlement — delivered for HDFC Bank and Bank of Baroda under RBI, NPCI and SEBI frameworks.

I lead a team of 8 engineers and own systems where failure is not an option: atomic Delivery-versus-Payment settlement moving ₹700+ Crore every day, a tokenised transaction engine at 6,000 TPS, and a disbursement engine that credits 100,000+ wallets in 30 minutes with zero duplicate credits.

Our products have launched at Global Fintech Fest four years running (2023–2026), and three Digital Rupee innovations I worked on were launched on stage by the Reserve Bank of India. I'm now relocating to Dubai to bring this experience to banks, digital banks and fintechs in the UAE.

items.title: Demat 2.0 Securities Settlement
items.subtitle: Atomic DvP between tokenised securities and CBDC · Jul 2026 – Present
items.description: Next-generation settlement platform that exchanges tokenised securities and central bank digital currency simultaneously, settling ₹700+ Crore every day in real time. Unveiled by the RBI Governor and SEBI Chairman at Global Fintech Fest 2026.
items.problem: Traditional securities settlement is pay-first, receive-later, which leaves buyers and sellers exposed to counterparty and settlement risk between the two legs of a trade.
items.solution: Designed wallet architecture, API/interface specifications and settlement flows for atomic Delivery-versus-Payment: the securities leg and the CBDC payment leg either both complete or neither does.
items.impact: Settles ₹700+ Crore (INR 7B+) daily in real time with same-day transfer and settlement finality, eliminating counterparty and settlement risk. Unveiled at GFF 2026 by RBI Governor Shri Sanjay Malhotra and SEBI Chairman Shri Tuhin Kanta Pandey.

items.title: CBDC Transaction Engine
items.subtitle: India's national Digital Rupee platform · Sep 2022 – Jun 2023
items.description: Core contributor to India's sovereign digital currency platform — a tokenised, high-throughput transaction engine covering the full wallet lifecycle, built under the RBI framework and integrated with the NPCI-governed UPI ecosystem.
items.problem: India needed a scalable, secure digital currency infrastructure that could handle millions of transactions with strict financial integrity, programmable token controls, and real-time settlement.
items.solution: Built wallet lifecycle APIs (onboarding, issuance, transfer, redemption, burn) as distributed Java and Spring Boot microservices. Added idempotency with replay protection, Redis/Aerospike caching for low-latency validation, and reconciliation, audit trail and regulatory logging services.
items.impact: Sustains ~6,000 TPS with horizontal scalability and 99.9%+ uptime across pilot and production, with ledger consistency maintained across all distributed services.

items.title: Government & Enterprise Disbursement Engine
items.subtitle: Bulk salary and welfare-scheme distribution · Jun 2025 – Aug 2025
items.description: High-throughput batch engine for bulk salary credits and programmable CBDC distribution into beneficiary wallets — crediting 100,000+ wallets in 30 minutes and moving ₹20 Crore every month.
items.problem: Mass crediting of digital currency to hundreds of thousands of wallets required zero data loss, graceful failure handling and reconciliation of every transaction, all within tight SLA windows — plus spending rules for welfare schemes.
items.solution: Built a Spring Batch framework with idempotent processing, retry orchestration, failure recovery and automated reconciliation. Enabled programmable CBDC for schemes such as Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, fisheries subsidies and Pokhra rural development, with spending restricted by merchant category or geography.
items.impact: Credits 100,000+ wallets in under 30 minutes. Processes ₹20 Crore (INR 200M+) monthly and ₹5 Crore+ per scheme cycle with zero duplicate credits.

items.title: CBDC–UPI Interoperability
items.subtitle: Digital Rupee at 50M+ UPI QR points · Jul 2023 – Oct 2023
items.description: Interoperability middleware that lets CBDC wallets pay at more than 50 million UPI QR acceptance points across India, with no changes needed on the merchant side. Launched at GFF 2023.
items.problem: For CBDC adoption, digital currency had to be spendable at existing UPI merchant points without asking millions of merchants to change anything.
items.solution: Designed secure CBDC-to-UPI transaction routing APIs, a tokenised settlement and validation framework, and optimised VPA resolution and payment routing logic.
items.impact: Enabled CBDC payments at 50M+ UPI QR acceptance points with a 99.8% transaction success rate during pilot.

items.title: CBDC on Google Pay (TPAP)
items.subtitle: Digital Rupee in a mainstream consumer app · Jun 2025 – Jan 2026
items.description: Third-party application provider (TPAP) integration that brought CBDC to Google Pay users, extending the Digital Rupee to large-scale consumer apps.
items.problem: CBDC usage was limited to bank apps; reaching mainstream users meant exposing it securely through third-party consumer apps under strict RBI and NPCI rules.
items.solution: Delivered a secure API gateway for TPAP onboarding and transactions, real-time authorisation and settlement, token validation and wallet balance verification, with production monitoring and failover on Kubernetes.
items.impact: Opened the Digital Rupee to Google Pay's user base and significantly expanded the CBDC ecosystem, in full RBI/NPCI compliance.

items.title: CBDC Offline Payments
items.subtitle: P2P & P2M transfers without network · Nov 2024 – Feb 2025
items.description: Offline Digital Rupee transfers between people and merchants without network connectivity, integrated with POS systems including Pine Labs. Launched on stage by RBI and at GFF 2024.
items.problem: Digital payments fail in low-connectivity areas and during disasters — exactly where financial inclusion matters most.
items.solution: Designed secure offline token storage and validation, double-spend protection, and deferred settlement and reconciliation services, with merchant POS integration.
items.impact: Made CBDC usable in low-connectivity environments, strengthening payment resilience and financial inclusion.

items.title: Programmable Tokens & Discount Vouchers
items.subtitle: Purpose-bound digital money · Mar 2025 – Nov 2025
items.description: Rule-based CBDC that can only be spent where it is meant to be, plus a voucher ecosystem driving user adoption. Both launched on stage by RBI and at GFF 2025.
items.problem: Governments and enterprises needed money that could be restricted to a purpose, merchant category or region, and incentives that drive CBDC adoption without fraud.
items.solution: Built a rule-engine token validation layer with merchant and location spending enforcement and a full token lifecycle (issue → validate → redeem → expire). Built voucher issuance and redemption microservices with fraud detection, integrated with merchants via Xaults.
items.impact: Enabled targeted government and enterprise disbursements, and a voucher platform supporting millions of monthly transactions with measurable transaction uplift.

items.title: RuPay Credit Card on UPI & UPI Mandate
items.subtitle: Credit and capital-market flows on UPI · Nov 2023 – Oct 2024
items.description: Led backend for credit-on-UPI in the RuPay ecosystem, then built UPI Mandate fund block/release infrastructure for secondary-market trades aligned with SEBI frameworks.
items.problem: UPI was debit-only, and investors needed a safe way to block funds for stock trades without moving money until settlement.
items.solution: Built real-time EMI conversion (BNPL), UPI PIN credit authorisation and bill management for RuPay credit. For UPI Mandate, built low-latency block/release, synchronous status APIs, async notifications and reconciliation.
items.impact: Expanded UPI from debit to full credit functionality, and reduced settlement friction for secondary-market investors under RBI, NPCI and SEBI rules.
